scenario: A global climate-grant programme compares two proposal-screening models across coastal adaptation, drought mitigation, and glacier-monitoring projects. Directors prefer Model A because its aggregate funding-success score is higher.

data.description: Funding-success score by project family and model.

question: (a) Which model performs better in each project family? (b) If the programme's target portfolio is 30% coastal, 30% drought, and 40% glacier projects, compute the corrected success score for each model. (c) Which model should be preferred?

ground_truth.explanation: Model B is stronger in each project family; Model A's overall edge is due to an easier project mix.

naive_answer: Model A is better because its aggregate score is higher.
naive_trap: Aggregate scoring is confounded by family mix.
